title: Household-Size Schedule for Late-Fee Reversals
content:
**Schedule.** Under the household-size schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a late-fee reversal on a Pre-K tuition account has an amount added by the number of the household's children holding a School Nutrition Services Meal Account in status active.

| Children of the household holding a School Nutrition Services meal account in status active | Added to the reversal |
|---|---|
| three or more | 3.00 |
| exactly two | 2.00 |
| one or none | nothing |

Every active meal account of the household counts, whatever its tier; an inactive account does not.

## Examples (hypothetical households)

- Four children, all with active meal accounts: 3.00 added.
- Two children with active meal accounts: 2.00 added.
- Only the Pre-K child has an active meal account: nothing added.
